## FT Music for Android

Download the attached `FT-Music-v*.apk` on an Android 8.0+ device. To update an existing installation signed with the same FT Music key, install the new APK over it; do not uninstall first if you want to retain app data. Android will ask for confirmation and check the signature. In the app, use **Library → Check for updates** for future GitHub releases.

This is an early prototype, not a full Prism replacement. Android device installation and live YouTube Music, LRCLIB, and download behavior have not been verified. YouTube search, playback and downloads use unofficial interfaces, can fail or change, and may be subject to YouTube's terms. Download only content you have permission to save. Optional FT Music account sync requires a separate private HTTPS server; it does not sync a YouTube account. Android Auto integration is not included.
